synthesis.title: Loanpoint API Boundary and Lifecycle Study
synthesis.headline: Two personas hit a shared contract-discovery problem: critical workflow inputs and actions were not exposed clearly enough to complete or verify core rules. Where the lifecycle flow was reachable, it revealed major rule and accounting defects in extensions, late fees, and overview totals.
